scope: Targeted primary-source and numerical-data review; not a systematic literature review

sources.title: Primitive genotype-phenotype coupling in fuel-dependent synthetic cells with an autocatalyst
sources.reviewed: Publisher indexed article text; author CSVs and plotting notebooks
sources.supported: Reciprocal effects between a chemically fueled compartment and a chemical autocatalyst
sources.limit: Compartment division with replicator inheritance remains future work; selectivity error is not sequence-copying fidelity
sources.role: Candidate integration spine and measured minutes-scale lifetime observations
sources.dataset_status: Three measured CSVs acquired; SHA256 and UTC recorded in datasets_manifest.json
sources.dataset_license: MIT at repository root; no separate data license seen

sources.title: Toward synthetic life—Emergence, growth, creation of offspring, decay, and rescue of fuel-dependent synthetic cells
sources.reviewed: Author-institution archived publisher article and institutional abstract
sources.supported: Fueled coacervates form offspring speckles, transmit molecules, and support refueling rescue
sources.limit: Does not establish integrated autocatalytic heredity, adaptive behavior, or indefinite self-maintenance
sources.role: Compartment generation and retention design constraint

sources.title: Darwinian properties and their trade-offs in autocatalytic RNA reaction networks
sources.reviewed: Indexed full publisher article including discussion and data availability
sources.supported: Network connectivity trades off reproduction, variation and robustness
sources.limit: Self-assembled complexes can pull compositions toward substrate-determined states, weakening heredity
sources.role: Require common-environment serial transfer and a carryover null
sources.dataset_status: Availability reviewed; sequencing data not downloaded

sources.title: Multispecies autocatalytic RNA reaction networks in coacervates
sources.reviewed: Indexed primary publisher and PMC article text
sources.supported: RNA autocatalytic networks operate within coacervates and give transient compositional protection
sources.limit: Leakage and exchange can erase compartment identity; no autonomous living entity
sources.role: Test retention against replication and dilution timescales

sources.title: Periodic temperature changes drive the proliferation of self-replicating RNAs in vesicle populations
sources.reviewed: Full publisher article, especially serial transfer and discussion
sources.supported: RNA propagation through seven serial transfer generations despite dilution and content loss
sources.limit: Prefabricated RNA fragments; authors state system cannot evolve under tested conditions or confer vesicle fitness benefit
sources.role: Explicit amplification-loss accounting; environmental cycling is an input, not self-generated control
sources.dataset_status: Source xlsx availability reviewed; not acquired

sources.title: Synthetic genetic polymers capable of heredity and evolution
sources.reviewed: Primary article abstract and PMC description
sources.supported: Alternative genetic polymers support information storage and selection with engineered polymerases
sources.limit: Engineered enzyme/DNA-mediated workflow; not autonomous XNA replication or a noncarbon organism
sources.role: Alternative heredity module only after energy/retention interface works

sources.title: Self-sustained Replication of an RNA Enzyme
sources.supported: Cross-catalytic RNA ligation and competition with roughly hour-scale doubling under supplied substrates
sources.limit: Designed RNA substrates, externally supplied feed, no whole-cell autonomy
sources.role: Replication time scale may exceed short-lived fueled-compartment lifetime; compatibility must be measured

sources.title: Darwinian Evolution of Self-Replicating DNA in a Synthetic Protocell
sources.reviewed: Primary publisher results and data availability
sources.supported: Selected self-replicating DNA in supplied liposome/translation systems
sources.limit: One repeated evolutionary campaign did not improve efficiency; external translation and handling are substantial supplied machinery
sources.role: Conventional positive comparator and warning against assuming every lineage improves
sources.dataset_status: Availability reviewed; raw reads not acquired
sources.license: CC-BY-4.0 article; ENA data license not separately verified

sources.title: Photo-induced currents and short-term memory for reservoir computing in a ferroelectric semiconductor
sources.status: primary preprint, July 2026; peer-review status not established
sources.reviewed: Author abstract and associated measured numerical archive
sources.supported: History-sensitive photocurrent responses under externally driven light sequences
sources.limit: Biased device plus preprocessing/readout; physical memory is not autonomous learning, life or cognition
sources.role: Separate material-memory component and instrumentation scale; no chemical-rate calibration

sources.title: Data and code for: Photo-induced currents and short-term memory for reservoir computing in a ferroelectric semiconductor
sources.authors: Chong, Majumdar, Zahn, Hansen, Everschor-Sitte, Meier
sources.reviewed: Zenodo API metadata, fig2 archive, author parameters and data columns
sources.supported: 19744 corrected-current rows, 400 input pulses, conditional pulse-average responses
sources.limit: Corrected and averaged observations, one supplied measurement sequence; not raw device replication or independent reconstruction of the baseline
sources.role: Descriptive 4-second history contrast, retained separately from synthetic laboratory output
sources.dataset_license: CC-BY-4.0 verified via API and retained metadata

sources.title: Bistability of compartmentalized autocatalytic systems at the dawn of hereditary variation
sources.status: peer-reviewed theoretical/computational primary study; not physical experiment
sources.reviewed: Primary indexed abstract and author model repository README/tree; full publisher text redirected to cookie page
sources.supported: Under specified model rules, two autocatalytic cycles admit alternative stable compositions, while random partition and environmental selection can shift population composition
sources.limit: Model supplies rates, environmental fitness coupling, division threshold and replacement rules; not evidence of measured chemical heredity, delayed-cue learning or an autonomous entity
sources.role: Mechanistic motivation for common-environment compositional memory tests and explicit selection/null controls; not validation of our model
sources.dataset_status: Code availability and README inspected, code not run or redistributed
sources.dataset_license: No license file seen in inspected tree; README contains research-use disclaimer only
